facts.fact: The National Communications Authority approved Starlink in April 2025, with licensing described as fast-tracked and full foreign ownership accommodated.

Starlink announced service live nationwide in Somalia on Monday 4 August 2025, sold direct via its website at $390 for hardware ($210 mini kit) and $70 a month, with no local retail presence or support team.

note: Amazon Kuiper mentioned only as a prospective entrant globally, not a fact for Somalia.
